name: Bed sampling based on variety growth stages
query:
SELECT 
    variety,
    variety_type,
    greenhouse,
    week_no as sampling_week,
    forecast_yield as current_week_yield,
    colour_break_forecast,
    colour_break_harvest_week,
    ball_stage_forecast,
    ball_stage_harvest_week,
    rice_stage_forecast,
    rice_stage_harvest_week,
    date as sampling_date
FROM `tabBed Sampling Form`
WHERE docstatus = 1
  AND date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)
ORDER BY variety, greenhouse, week_no
report_name: Bed sampling based on variety growth stages
